title: On irreducible representations of quandles
summary: We consider irreducible representations of finite quandles over $\mathbb{C}$. For $Q$ a finite quandle whose inner automorphism group $Inn(Q)$ have trivial Schur multipliers, we prove that the irreducible representations of $Q$ can be constructed out of what we call characters of $Q$ and irreducible linear represenations of the group $Inn(Q)$.
